asyncLead: “{{title}}” starts a wait. What is it waiting on? The task will depend on it.
asyncDoneLead: It was asynchronous, and nothing records what it is waiting on. Name the wait to keep an eye on it, or cancel.
delegationWaitReleasedByTask: This wait is released when its delegated task is done — it can't be released by hand.
delegationWaitHasNoCheck: A delegated task's wait has no check-by to complete.
noCheckBy: This expectation has no check-by, so there's no check to complete.
notAWait: Only an Expectation, or a wait's check task, can be released or checked on.
bindNotATask: Only a Task can be bound to a wait.
bindNoPlace: This task hangs somewhere a wait can't be placed beside it.
